title: Compressed Blocks+
description: Compressed Blocks+ adds compact versions of common blocks like Cobblestone, Dirt, and Sand, for easier storage and building.
body:
Jono’s Compressed Blocks adds compact versions of some of Minecraft’s most common blocks, making storage and building easier. The early preview includes:

Compressed Cobblestone, Dirt, and Sand

Simple crafting recipes to compress and decompress blocks.
